reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes L1₂ precipitates form in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni, whereas Al additions typically stabilize BCC/B2 phases, and the proposed mechanism linking coherent precipitates to simultaneous improvements in all four disparate properties is oversimplified and lacks mechanistic specificity.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comparative, but the falsification criterion is weak because a null result (no improvement) could stem from suboptimal processing rather than a false hypothesis, and the test does not isolate the proposed mechanism from other microstructural changes.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis targets a relevant property combination but is of limited use because it proposes a phase (L1₂) that is not characteristic of the Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni system, making it a misleading starting point for researchers in this field.
